title: 拜靖国神社，日本再次撕下自己的“和平伪装”（钟声）
title_en: By visiting Yasukuni Shrine, Japan once again tears off its own 'peace disguise' (Bell Sound)
summary: 人民日报“钟声”文章指出，日本首相高市早苗10月17日以“内阁总理大臣”名义向靖国神社供奉祭品，19日又委托自民党高官供奉祭祀费，秋季大祭期间多名政要献祭参拜。文章批评靖国神社是军国主义精神工具，近日公开的会议记录显示日本政府曾秘密安排合祀
summary_en: A People's Daily 'Bell' article noted that Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae made offerings to Yasukuni Shrine in the name of 'Prime Minister' on Oct 17, and on Oct 19 entrusted a senior LDP official to offer ritual fees; many political figures made offerings and visits during the autumn festival. The article criticized Yasukuni Shrine as a spiritual tool of militarism, and recently disclosed meeting records showed the Japanese government had secretly arranged joint enshrinement.

summary_en: A People's Daily article pointed out that Lai Ching-te's Oct 10 'Double Ten' speech stubbornly adhered to the separatist 'Taiwan independence' stance, hyped the 'mainland threat,' advocated 'democracy versus authoritarianism,' and spread the illusions of 'relying on foreign powers for independence' and 'seeking independence by force.' title: 环球扫描
title_en: Global Scan
summary: 《生物多样性公约》第十七次缔约方大会在埃里温开幕，将首次全球审查“昆蒙框架”落实进展。国际货币基金组织、世界银行与泰国央行发布“曼谷蓝图”，呼吁跨境合作打击金融诈骗。伊朗总统表示绝不屈服于“侵略性”国家无理要求与霸凌，军方称已制定应对方案。
summary_en: The 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity opened in Yerevan and will conduct the first global review of progress on the Kunming-Montreal Framework. The IMF, World Bank and Bank of Thailand released the 'Bangkok Blueprint,' calling for cross-border cooperation to combat financial fraud. Iran's president said Iran will never yield to unreasonable demands and bullying from 'aggressive' countries, and the military said response plans are in place.

summary: 巴西高等选举法院当地时间10月25日晚公布总统选举第二轮投票计票结果，劳工党候选人、现任总统卢拉以51.79%的得票率战胜自由党候选人、前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，后者得票率为48.21%，卢拉赢得连任。卢拉将于2027年
summary_en: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court released the second-round results of the presidential election late on October 25 local time. Workers' Party candidate and incumbent President Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party candidate and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, by 51.79% to 48.21%, winning re-election. Lula will take office in 2027.

summary: 西非经济货币联盟报告预计，2026年其8个成员国整体经济增速为6.3%，全年平均通胀率约1.2%；非洲开发银行预测西非地区今年增长4.7%，高于非洲大陆4.2%的平均水平。几内亚、科特迪瓦、贝宁等多国增速有望突破6%，其中几内亚以8.7%居
summary_en: The West African Economic and Monetary Union report forecasts overall economic growth of 6.3% for its eight member states in 2026, with an average annual inflation rate of about 1.2%. The African Development Bank predicts West Africa will grow 4.7% this year, higher than the African continent's average of 4.2%. Several countries, including Guinea, Côte d'Ivoire and Benin, are expected to exceed 6% growth, with Guinea topping the list at 8.7%.

summary: 中吉两国外长发表联合新闻公报，回顾建交47年成果，表示将继续相互支持并拓展务实合作。吉方赞赏中方构建人类命运共同体理念及“一带一路”和全球发展、安全、文明、治理倡议；中方赞赏吉方为维护地区和平稳定所作的贡献。双方就非洲之角局势及红海航道安全
summary_en: The foreign ministers of China and Kyrgyzstan issued a joint press communique, reviewing the achievements of 47 years of diplomatic relations and stating they will continue to support each other and expand practical cooperation. The two sides discussed the situation in the Horn of Africa and the security of Red Sea shipping lanes.

title: 尼泊尔努力挖掘经济潜能
title_en: Nepal works to unlock its economic potential
summary: 尼泊尔央行报告显示，2025/2026财年经济增速预计达3.85%，通胀率控制在3.5%以下，总体温和可控。服务业贡献率为61.81%，工业稳步扩张，农业因干旱和反常降雨增速回落。进出口均实现两位数增长，国际收支盈余，外汇储备升至近3.9万
summary_en: Nepal's central bank reported that economic growth is projected at 3.85% in fiscal year 2025/2026, with inflation kept below 3.5%, generally moderate and controllable. Services contributed 61.81%, industry expanded steadily, and agricultural growth slowed due to drought and abnormal rainfall. Both exports and imports achieved double-digit growth, the balance of payments was in surplus, and foreign exchange reserves rose to nearly 3.9 trillion.

summary_en: The Economic Advisory Council of Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs released a trade policy assessment report, using data and research to respond to European panic about a 'China shock', arguing that industries such as automobiles and machinery manufacturing have entered a new stage of competition, should defend open market principles, and should not equate economic security with isolationism. The report notes that the main cause of decline in German industry is locational factors and cost burdens, and deep-rooted problems.

summary_en: The 54th World Artistic Gymnastics Championships concluded in Rotterdam, Netherlands. summary_en: Global food waste accounts for about one-fifth of available food consumption each year, and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization says the world is still far from the 2030 target for reducing food waste. summary: 2026年塞内加尔中国电影节在达喀尔开幕，约100名两国嘉宾出席并观看开场电影《捕风追影》。中国驻塞内加尔大使李志刚在致辞中表示，电影是跨越国界、沟通心灵的桥梁，希望通过电影让塞内加尔观众更直观感受中国的历史底蕴、时代风貌和社会生活。塞内加
summary_en: The 2026 China Film Festival in Senegal opened in Dakar, with about 100 guests from both countries attending and watching the opening film "Chasing Wind and Shadow." Chinese Ambassador to Senegal Li Zhigang said in his speech that film is a bridge that crosses borders and connects hearts, and he hoped that through film, Senegalese audiences could feel more directly China's historical heritage, contemporary features and social life. title: “长征精神具有跨越时空的重要价值”
title_en: The Long March spirit holds great value transcending time and space
summary: 10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京举行，习近平主席发表重要讲话。国际人士受访表示，长征精神不仅属于中国，也属于全人类，具有跨越时空的重要价值，为新时代中国走好新的长征路、推进中国式现代化指明方向。俄中友协副主席、西班牙
summary_en: On October 22, a conference commemorating the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March was held in Beijing, where President Xi Jinping delivered an important speech. International figures interviewed said the Long March spirit belongs not only to China but to all humanity, has important value transcending time and space, and points the way for China in the new era to take a new Long March and advance Chinese modernization.
